scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.iac.json && cd apps/backend && bun run typecheck && cd ../web && bun run typecheck && cd ../mobile && bun run typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun run build
scripts.update-stack-secrets: GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) bunx alchemy deploy stacks/github.ts --profile admin --stage bootstrap --yes && echo "" && echo "NOTE: this rotated the CI token and the R2 key pair." && echo "Any already-deployed stage still runs with the previous keys (image signing and the sender are baked at deploy)." && echo "Redeploy every stage that matters: bunx alchemy deploy --stage prod --yes"
